t: Gardener: Add consistency audit pass — detect and fix deprecated patterns across all spoke skill files
description: The Gardener currently checks spoke structural health (hooks, settings, version) but never audits skill file content for deprecated patterns. This means humans discover stale references (WAI-Lugs.jsonl, WAI-Session-Log.jsonl, countdown closeout patterns, renamed advisors) only by accident. The Gardener should own this proactively: scan all skill files on every nightly run, auto-fix safe patterns, and generate remediation lugs for complex ones. This is Pass 0 — runs before any spoke tends.
perceive: Read wheel-tender.sh to understand Pass structure (Pass 1/2/3). Read verify_health.py for the health check pattern to model after. Read remediate.sh to understand how fixes are applied. Identify where Pass 0 should be inserted (before Pass 1).
execute: 1. Create audit_consistency.py with a RULES catalog. Each rule: pattern (regex), scope (files to scan), severity (auto_fix|flag), fix (replacement or None), description. Initial rules: (a) WAI-Lugs.jsonl in scope.writes fields → bytype/ paths [auto_fix in WAI-Skills.jsonl], (b) WAI-Session-Log.jsonl refs → flag, (c) lugs/active/ refs → flag, (d) advisors/Librarian/ paths → advisors/Expediter/ [auto_fix], (e) 'Proceeding with commit in N' countdown patterns in closeout skills → flag. Script outputs: list of auto-fixes applied + list of flagged issues. For each flagged issue, create a lug at hub/WAI-Spoke/lugs/bytype/task/open/task-consistency-fix-{hash}.json with the specific file, line, pattern, and suggested fix. 2. Add Pass 0 block to wheel-tender.sh: runs audit_consistency.py --hub-path $HUB_DIR --spokes-file <(registry spoke paths), logs to PASS0 prefix, reports counts.
verify: python3 audit_consistency.py --hub-path /home/mario/projects/wheelwright/hub returns report. Running it detects WAI-Lugs.jsonl in WAI-Hub/skills/lug-advisor/wai-lug-advisor.md. Running it on a clean file returns 0 issues. Auto-fix on WAI-Skills.jsonl scope.writes replaces WAI-Lugs.jsonl with correct bytype/ path.
acceptance_criteria: audit_consistency.py exists with RULES catalog of at least 5 deprecated patterns
Script auto-fixes safe patterns (WAI-Skills.jsonl scope.writes, Librarian path refs)
Script generates remediation lugs for complex patterns needing AI judgment
wheel-tender.sh has Pass 0 block that runs audit_consistency.py before Pass 1
Pass 0 logs PASS0_FIX and PASS0_FLAG entries to the nightly log
Running the tender nightly will catch any future regression in skill files
